title: session-rewind-bisect-canary-with-on-demand-rollback-credit-pool
author: Priya Nair
release_notes: Adds session-rewindable canary controller with deterministic bisect tooling and a rollback credit pool to allow controlled staged rollbacks and on-demand micro-bisecting. Backwards-compatible; opt-in via rollout policy. Includes docs and migration.
description: Context: We need safer canary recoveries for long-running session-sensitive endpoints. This PR implements a session-rewindable canary flow with an on-demand bisect utility and a rollback credit pool that limits automated rollbacks to a configurable budget. Motivation: previously a single noisy metric spike could trigger broad rollbacks or expensive manual bisects; this design lets SREs perform deterministic micro-bisects while protecting production by bounding automatic rollback churn. Scope: controller changes, DB migration for rollback credits, telemetry events, canary bisect CLI, integration tests, and docs. Checklist: - [x] Design doc: /docs/design/session-rewind-bisect.md - [x] Linear tickets linked: ENG-3245, ENG-8891 - [x] Migration tested locally and in staging - [x] E2E replay/bisect test added - [x] Docs and runbook updated: docs/rollouts/session_rewind.md What this does (high level): - Adds SessionRewindController which tracks session-affine requests during a canary window and enables replaying affected sessions against candidate model variants to compute a deterministic divergence score. - Introduces rollback_credit table and a lightweight credit allocator. Rollout policies can reserve credits; automatic rollback consumes credits, manual/expedited rollback can consume bypass tokens. - Implements a deterministic bisect harness (server-side) that can run intra-canary binary search on suspect cohorts to isolate problematic commit ranges without full traffic cutover. - Emits new telemetry events: rollback_credit.{allocated,consumed,refunded}, session_rewind.{snapshot_created,played_back,divergence_computed}. - Opt-in: controllers default to legacy behavior unless rolloutSpec.enableSessionRewind=true. Migration: adds migrations/2026_02_18_add_rollback_credits.sql (idempotent). Risks & mitigations: - Storage growth for session snapshots: snapshots are TTLed and sampled using lossy sampling strategy; default sampling 1 in 1000 for high-throughput endpoints. - Bisect load: bisect jobs run on isolated worker pool with tight CPU/GPU limits and early abort heuristics. Live demo: internal runbook and demo video linked in design doc.
